thread:
Ana: quick sync — we need to rebalance the observability slices for the console before sprint planning. customer asks piled up, and we also have linking work for traces + cost breakdown.
Matt: ok — what's highest risk if we cut scope? dashboards vs tracing hooks vs cost attribution?
Sam: from CS — enterprise customer asked for per-route cost and an error-reason breakdown in the console by EOD next quarter. high priority for renewals.
Sophie: tracing hooks add developer signal but are more invasive (agent + sampling). dashboards are lower-risk UX work but give less signal for root cause.
Elaine: infra note — tracing hooks will increase ingest ~20% at P95 if we keep current spans. we can mitigate with adaptive sampling but that means more complexity and delayed delivery.
Ana: proposal: ship lightweight cost breakdown + error analytics (customer-facing) in phase 1, postpone full tracing hook rollout to phase 2 behind a canary.
Priya: design can do a compact cost panel and an error-reasons modal in 1 sprint. need acceptance criteria to scope properly.
Matt: sounds doable. for tracing hooks we should schedule work to implement server-side sampling + opt-in flag for Dedicated customers first.
Sophie: agree. also recommend adding a short eval to verify error-reason accuracy against known regressions (prompt/eval style) before launch.
Ana: acceptance checklist (draft):
```
- Cost panel: per-route token cost + 7d trend
- Error analytics: grouped by error-reason, with top-3 example traces
- UX: drilldown modal + export CSV
- SLO gating: staging rollout with synthetic traffic and <5% false-positive error-reasons
- Docs: short how-to + migration notes for Dedicated/Private
```
Matt: add-on: telemetry events need stable names; please standardize event schema (we'll coordinate with eng-infra).
Elaine: infra asks: add a retention plan for detailed traces (30d cold, 7d hot) if/when tracing hooks go live. we can't store full traces indefinitely.
Sam: customer note: they want CSV export of cost per-service table. please add to the checklist.
Priya: UX question — do we show cost as absolute $ or normalized tokens? customer asked for dollars.
Ana: show both: default dollars, toggle tokens. add to acceptance.
Matt: timeline suggestion: cost + error analytics in sprint 12 (two-week), design + docs in sprint 11. tracing hooks planned for sprint 14 with a canary rollout.
Sophie: canary plan: 5% traffic for a week, synthetic smoke tests, fallback to aggregated tracing on errors.
Ana: prioritization decision: phase 1 = cost panel + error analytics + CSV export + docs. phase 2 = tracing hooks + adaptive sampling + retention policy. we'll bring to roadmap review.
Matt: noted. I'll file tech spec and a small RFC for sampling strategy.
Priya: will share a first mock by EOD tomorrow.
DeployBot: scheduled a deploy window for staging: 2091150000 — run smoke + telemetry validation. :robot_face:
Ana: thanks all — next steps: Matt files spec, Priya posts mocks, Sophie outlines evals, Elaine drafts retention cost estimate. I'll add this to roadmap board as a slice-rebalance ticket.
Sam: great — I'll update the customer and share their exact CSV columns.
Matt: +1 — will sync with eng-infra on event schema tomorrow. :thumbsup:
